info.name: Invoice Generator Nigeria API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Invoice Generator Nigeria - A Nigeria-focused invoice generator with WhatsApp integration and Paystack payments.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT Bearer token authentication. Use the Sign In endpoint to get a token, then set it in the collection variables.

## Base URL
- Production: https://invoecr-1.onrender.com/api/v1
- Development: http://localhost:5000/api/v1

item.name: Authentication
item.description: User authentication endpoints for sign up and sign in.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "My Business Name",
    "email": "business@example.com",
    "password": "SecurePassword123!",
    "confirm_password": "SecurePassword123!",
    "type": "business",
    "phone": "+2348012345678",
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "address": "123 Business Street, Lagos, Nigeria"
}

request.description:
Create a new user account.

**Required Fields:**
- name: Business/User name
- email: Valid email address
- password: Strong password
- confirm_password: Must match password

**Optional Fields:**
- type: 'business', 'staff', or 'individual'
- phone: Phone number
- first_name, last_name: Personal names
- logo: URL to logo image
- address: Business address

Authenticate an existing user and receive a JWT token.

The token is automatically saved to collection variables for use in other requests.

request.description:
Create a new invoice.

**Note:** Either `customer_id` (existing customer) OR `customer` object (new customer) is required.

**Templates available:**
- pdf0, pdf1, pdf2, pdf3 (legacy)
- invoice1, invoice2, invoice3 (HTML templates)
Create invoice for an existing customer using their ID.

item.name: Subscription
item.description: Subscription management endpoints - plans, upgrades, limits, and renewals.

request.description:
Get all available subscription plans. No authentication required.

**Plans:**
- Free: 10 invoices/month, 5 customers
- Basic (₦2,000/mo): Unlimited invoices/customers
- Premium (₦3,500/mo): + Analytics, recurring invoices
- Enterprise (₦5,000/mo): + White-label, API access
Get subscription plans comparison data for pricing page.
Get the authenticated entity's current subscription details.
Check current usage against subscription limits.

Check if a specific feature is available.

**Features:**
whatsappSharing, pdfExport, onlinePayments, analytics, recurringInvoices, taxReports, whiteLabel, apiAccess
Check if user has saved cards for subscription upgrade.

Upgrade to a higher subscription plan.

Requires a saved card for payment.
Downgrade to a lower subscription plan.
Renew the current subscription. CardId is optional - uses default card if not specified.
Get subscriptions expiring soon. For admin/monitoring.
Trigger automatic renewal processing. For cron jobs/admin.

item.name: Card
item.description: Card management endpoints - save, charge, and manage payment cards via Paystack.

request.description:
Start the card saving process via Paystack.

Returns an authorization URL to redirect the user for card verification (₦1 charge).

Verify payment and save card.

**Note:** In production, cards are saved automatically via Paystack webhook. This is for testing/fallback.
Get all saved cards for the entity.
Set a card as the default payment method.

Charge a saved card.

**Amount:** In kobo (e.g., 500000 = ₦5,000)

**cardId:** Optional - uses default card if not specified
Check if a card was saved via webhook.
Delete a saved card.
